profile.name: Rafael Martin E. Aquino
profile.headline: Junior Software Developer | IT Support
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate and full-stack developer with hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications using React, Vue.js, Node.js, Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. Experienced in IT support, system troubleshooting, application maintenance, and database management within a government environment. Currently building cybersecurity and SOC analyst capabilities through focused training in security fundamentals, networking, authentication, and log analysis.
about: I'm a Computer Science graduate from the University of Baguio who builds reliable, user-focused web applications across the full stack. I split my time between software development and IT support work within a government environment, which has given me practical experience in building internal tools, maintaining systems, and solving real technical problems for end users.

Alongside development, I'm actively developing cybersecurity and SOC analyst skills. I'm focused on security fundamentals, networking, authentication and access control, and basic log analysis, with the goal of contributing to security operations as a SOC analyst.
